تبتلعون (form VIII)
# تَبْتَلِعُونَ (tabtaliʕūna) /tab.ta.li.ʕuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِبْتَلَعَ (ibtalaʕa)
# تُبْتَلَعُونَ (tubtalaʕūna) /tub.ta.la.ʕuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِبْتَلَعَ (ibtalaʕa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
